name: Shaun “Slaw” Durbin
tagline: Philadelphia muralist. Designer of the Belfield Recreation Center interior murals.
bio: Shaun Durbin paints as Slaw. He is a muralist in Philadelphia and is listed as an artist with Mural Arts Philadelphia.

He designed the interior murals at the Belfield Recreation Center in East Germantown (2022), a Mural Arts project. The murals show cartoon-like characters doing the things people do in and around the rec center.

consent.listed: Agreed to be listed; told to Ian Swain, recorded 2026-11-08
